name: Passing Word of a Threat
label: Quest
description: Advisor Belgrum has read Historian Karnik's note and sends you back to Karnik with a message spoken on the king's authority: act on what is known…
intro: Advisor Belgrum has read Historian Karnik's note and sends you back to Karnik with a message spoken on the king's authority: act on what is known, swiftly and decisively, and halt the Shadowforge's doings in the Badlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Advisor Belgrum reaches the end of the note, and his eyes widen for a moment.
Friend, please return to Historian Karnik and tell him on the king's authority to act on this information swiftly and decisively. He must halt the Shadowforge's activities in the Badlands.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're treating this matter with an urgency I'd expect from the king himself, friend.
All right, then. I know what'll bring the Shadowforge down.
Their presence in Uldaman can be slowed if we strike them at their base of operations: Angor Fortress.
